description: Terrarium DEM mosaic for the site's default 25 km study area
encoding: Terrarium RGB: elevation_m = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768
notes: Mosaic preserves source tile pixels without resampling. Web Mercator zoom 12 pixel spacing is about 37 m at the center; native terrain source resolution may be lower. This is DEM elevation, not land cover or clutter classification.
